name: plan-leaves-code-answerable-questions-open-and-skips-adjacent-existing-path-fails-planning-rounds
description: The plan for a change to a core flow (such as landing) leaves open questions that reading the code would settle, and assumes one mode of operation while an existing shipped path (such as parallel max_concurrency > 1) also runs through it. The critic finds both only after the last planning round and the job fails before any code is written.
